{{Quote|Station Theta Black is scheduled for demolition today.|Captain Phasma, to Major Elrik Vonreg|<ref name="STB" />}}
'''Station Theta Black''' was a [[space station]] in the [[Unknown Regions]] utilized by the [[First Order]] during the [[Cold War]] to [[Mining|mine]] and process [[dedlanite]] to make [[blaster]]s. It was located in an [[asteroid field]], attached to one of the [[asteroid]]s.

==History==
By [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Station Theta Black had been decommissioned and was scheduled for demolition. On the day of demolition, two [[Resistance]] pilots, [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Kazuda Xiono]], along with [[astromech droid]]s [[BB-8]] and [[CB-23]], [[Mission to Station Theta Black|visited]] the station investigating coordinates the Resistance had acquired as a result of Xiono's [[spy]]ing [[Mission on the Colossus platform|mission]] on [[Castilon]].<ref name="STB" />

[[File:MissionToStationThetaBlack-StationThetaBlack.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Resistance pilots escape the station]]
Xiono was concerned about entering the station, but Dameron insisted. Inside the station, the two destroyed a [[First Order sentry droid|sentry droid]], causing an alarm to be sent back to [[Starkiller Base]]. This led [[Captain]] [[Phasma]] to decide to accompany the demolition crew personally, and she ordered [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] and his squadron along as well. After being alerted to the First Order's arrival by CB-23, who had taken the [[T-70 X-wing starfighter|X-wings]] and hidden among the asteroids, Dameron, Xiono, and BB-8 found their way to the control room. There, they located and copied data about the station's mining operations before fighting their way to the catwalks in the main hangar, where CB-23 brought the fighters in to pick them up.<ref name="STB" />

While this was going on, Phasma's [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] were placing the explosives for the demolition at all points in the station. After the Resistance fighters had left the station, Phasma and her troopers evacuated in their [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|shuttle]]. Dameron and Xiono briefly fought with Vonreg and his squadron near the station, before Phasma ordered Vonreg to retreat as the explosives were about to go off. When the station was demolished, the First Order ships were already gone, and Xiono and Dameron were forced to outpace the blast wave while weaving through asteroids. Dameron managed to do so, while Xiono weathered it by shielding his fighter behind an asteroid. The two then returned to a Resistance corvette to report their findings to [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="STB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Station Theta Black first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' [[Station Theta Black (episode)|episode]] of the same name.<ref name="STB" />
